name: Stinking Up Southshore
label: Quest
description: Stinking Up Southshore: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Celebrate Hallow's End in style... By bringing grief to our enemies in Southshore!

Take one of these specially crafted stink bombs. It is filled with an odiferous funk that no human - or any weak-willed beast for that matter - can stand to smell. You'll need to throw it right in the heart of Southshore for it to do its job, so be prepared for a fight against the Alliance!
When you've completed this task... This tribute to our liberation, return to me!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you delivered our "gift" to the people of Southshore?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, well done! I hope the Alliance chokes on the foul gift we've given them, much like we were forced to choke on the yoke of enslavement to the Scourge!

You've kept the ideas of Hallow's End true, friend, and for that I salute you. As an extra bonus, let me share some of these Hallow's End treats I have with you. I think you might find them to be quite the enjoyable diversion!
